_comment: MON/USDC listing for monad-mainnet (DEPLOYMENT.md §3, §6 phase 3; values from PARAMETERS.md). Read by script/ProposeListing.s.sol (LISTING=mon-usdc), which refuses zero addresses: the publisher addresses must still be filled in, before proposing. Verified on Monad mainnet (chain 143) on 2026-10-11: underlying = WMON 0x3bd3…433A (18 decimals, docs.monad.xyz token list); asset = native USDC 0x7547…b603 (6 decimals, Circle and docs.monad.xyz); Pyth MON/USD id 0x3149…6cd1 (Hermes: Crypto.MON/USD, live on Monad's Pyth with ~5 bps confidence) and USDC/USD id 0xeaa0…c94a; settlement feed = Chainlink MON/USD reference feed 0xBcD7…22fb (8 decimals, 1 h heartbeat, 2% deviation, Chainlink category 'new'); quote feed = Chainlink USDC/USD reference feed 0xf5F1…ebec (8 decimals, 1 h heartbeat). Both feeds were live with readable previous rounds; the -shared-svr 18-decimal variants are deliberately not used. USDC/USD rounds can be 3,606 s apart, so maxLegSkew stays well above 3,600. MON was ~0.026 USDC at verification: strikes span 0.0001 to 10 USDC; maxReportLifetime is MON's 300 s (PARAMETERS.md §4); the short cap of 10,000,000 MON (~260k USDC) is a conservative phase-3 start, to be confirmed by the risk review. Amounts are in USDC's 6 decimals; strikes and caps in 1e18. ZERO-USDC LAUNCH: bootstrapFromFees = true lists with insuranceSeed and keeperReserveMin at 0 (no treasury deposits); insurance then fills from 60% and the keeper reserve from 10% of every fee. Until it has grown, a writer shortfall at expiry falls on that group's holders through the recovery ratio and keepers earn no USDC reward, so keep the short cap low and run the keepers yourself.
